name: Automatic Garage Order
author: jor
description: Reorders the pitlane garages in Career Mode and Grand Prix each season according to Constructors' Championship merit.

options.label: Pitlane Garage Order
options.description: Choose how pitlane garages are assigned: Championship standings (merit), Inverted (P1 gets last garage), or Randomized.

options.label: Apply in Season 1
options.description: Apply realistic 2024/2025 constructor standings in Season 1 (McLaren in Garage 1, Ferrari in Garage 2, etc.).

options.label: Apply in Grand Prix
options.description: Apply pitlane garage reordering in Grand Prix mode as well as Career Mode.

options.label: Legacy: Reverse order
options.description: Legacy toggle: Inverts the pitlane garage order (equivalent to selecting Inverted standings).

options.label: Verbose logging
options.description: Log team names and assigned pitlane garage slots to swofty/loader.log.
